audit: Read-only CPU aggregation of existing logs; no model inference or new rollouts.

config.method: AdaJEPA App. A.2: pusht_noise replay with swapped shape + contact bias (placement: source, action bias/noise px: 9.0/10.0) + quality gate
config.state_alignment: observation/state before action at same index

training_data_recipe.formula: a_exec = a_source + 9 * (object_CoG - pusher) / norm(object_CoG - pusher) + 10 * Normal(0,I_2) [pixels]; environment input = a_exec / 100; store executed actions.

b_training_screen.settings: seed0, 3epochs, effective batch64, TS0.01, no decoder, identical initial backbone parameters and sampler order; EVAL50 development targets, 30 replans, frozen model; no planning correction.
b_training_screen.B1_formula: Per5-step prediction pair, w=1+I[visual_effect OR proprio_effect], normalized by global batch mean; replace JEPA prediction MSE by weighted MSE; TS unchanged. Coverage98.10% in final training epoch.
b_training_screen.B2_formula: L_IDM=mean||g([meanpatch(v[t+1]-v[t]),p[t+1]-p[t]])-a[t:t+5]||^2; g=MLP394->256->10 with GELU; use real encoded frames at0,5,10,15 and each corresponding5executed actions. No action embedding input. lambda=.418538541733931.
b_training_screen.B3_formula: For branches visual/proprio, layer-normalize each per-sample embedding without affine parameters (eps1e-5). D_b(i,j)=mean((LN(z_b[i])-LN(z_b[j]))^2), NOT RMS distance. Loss=global positive-branch-pair mean of [max(0,.2-D_b(i,j))]^2 for pairs(0,5),(5,10),(10,15),(0,15). No negative/static contraction term. lambda=2.4677111194988774.

method.distance: D_alpha(z,zprime)=mean((visual-visualprime)^2)+alpha*mean((proprio-proprioprime)^2), alpha=1; latent has visual and proprio branches; proprio may encode velocity.
method.trigger: r_t=sqrt(D(z_t,z_{t-W})/max(D(z_t,z_goal),1e-12)), W=3; w_t=clip((0.15-r_t)/(0.15-0.05),0,1). Store observation and w whenever positive; re-encode all memory observations with current adapted encoder every replan.
method.regularizer: P(A)=sum_h c_h sum_j [w_j D(m_j,g)/(H+1)] [max(0,1-D_sp(z_h,m_j)/(beta D_sp(m_j,g)))]^2 / sum_h c_h; c_h=2^h, beta=.25, kappa=2. Distances/rho clamped at1e-12. Sum over memories (not averaged), persistent memory until episode reset, no deduplication.
method.radius: beta multiplies squared distance; corresponding Euclidean radius is sqrt(beta)=0.5 times goal distance. Goal outside each memory support when beta<1. At exact center a squared radial kernel has zero own gradient; no escape guarantee.
method.proprio: Boost alpha by10 for the next3 plan calls after a trigger, renewed each trigger. Implementation scales both predicted and target proprio bysqrt(10) before original objective. Baseline trigger distance uses alpha1 even during boost.
method.switch: If stalled and (bar_l[t-W]-bar_l[t])/max(bar_l[t-W],1e-12)<theta=.05, activate corrections; bar_l[t]=(l[t-2]+l[t-1]+l[t])/3, W=3, K=1. l is newest not-yet-updated transition prediction MSE. Switch occurs after env feedback and effects begin next plan. Once switched remains active; updates CONTINUE unless freeze control explicitly true.
method.objective: Maze: weighted all-frame objective including context, weights normalized then averaged over T=H+1 frames. PushObj: last-frame objective for MPC iter<H, then same all-frame objective. GD Adam lr.1,100 iterations,zero init, warm starts unexecuted actions.
method.action_offset: K2P uses physical pusher displacement<10px over3 replans, checks start=10 (next plan is eleventh execution), min gap4, max7 escapes. On escape add v/||v||*min(15px,||v||/5) to each of5 executed env actions, v=goal pusher position-current pusher; prop boost10 for kick plus2 replans. This is a separate physical trigger branch, NOT combined with latent-memory main T0SP arm.
method.training: Bias data collection can use simulator object CoG. Deployed latent trigger/regularizer/proprio weight use observed images/proprio and goal observation, no oracle object state. K2P uses pusher goal proprio. Training observer B labels also not the same as online stall trigger.

limitations: All intervention comparisons are repeatedly used development targets; no independent confirmatory holdout or new multi-seed intervention result exists.
PushObj four checkpoint/planner combinations share the same350 tasks; cannot pool as1400 independent episodes or four independent replications.
Maze best SZ-switch selected among several developer arms:30replans66/100 vs63/100;50replans87/100 vs82/100, p=.125 at50. No statistically significant general Maze improvement demonstrated.
SZ-switch is penalty-only and has no PushObj counterpart in E3; strongest PushObj result uses proprio reweighting. Do not present per-domain selected maxima as one tested fixed policy.
Old Maze action_repeat1 failures and corrected action_repeat4 E3 run are different temporal protocols. All arms within E3 use4.

Training recipe combines action bias9px, noise10px, original-source placement with retries/jitter, contact selection and filtering; historical released-model comparison does not isolate action bias or match all training factors.

Historical report.md source-placement description is stale; generation_config.json is actual recipe. Bias/noise parameters calibrated with author released evaluation-segment statistics; targets are development data.
Author training-source/test-source overlap cannot be ruled out; source training/own validation pools are separated, but original author evaluation ancestry is unverified.

Three historical training seeds exist; four B training-screen arms and intervention studies use one training seed. Historical bias16k seed0 differs from new B0 (no decoder, initialization/runtime differences); do not combine B0 62.86 with old corrected72.29 as a paired gain.

Negative B2/B3 do not causally establish collapse, goal conflict, or impossibility of representation regularization. Common-candidate diagnostics are fixed candidate choice, not MPC success nor an oracle reachability bound.
Moving losses are on different transitions; loss gate is not a convergence/overfitting/learnability detector. Freezing controls lower Maze success; adaptation should continue.

Planning-stage gain is largely pusher-goal completion: old40replan T0SP rescues37/54 object-already-tolerant failures and2/78 object-not-at-goal failures. This breakdown is40budget and should not be silently called30budget.
Penalty is a compact-support latent repulsion, not demonstrated learned geodesic distance, progress guarantee, globally optimal planning, or novel general potential-field principle.
B3 positive-effect separation differs from planning-stage stagnation memory regularizer; failure of one does not test the other.
